a_coxph_hr

Source: R/deprecate.R
a_coxph_hr.Rd

a_coxph_hr Use tern:::a_coxph_pairwise()instead, and usetern::coxph_pairwise()` as the layout-level wrapper.

Usage

a_coxph_hr(
  df,
  .var,
  ref_path,
  .spl_context,
  ...,
  .stats = NULL,
  .formats = NULL,
  .labels = NULL,
  .indent_mods = NULL
)

Arguments

df

(data.frame)
input data frame.

.var

(string)
name of the response variable.

ref_path

(character)
path to the reference group.

.spl_context

(environment)
split context environment.

...

Additional arguments passed to the statistics function.

.stats

(character)
statistics to calculate.

.formats

(list)
formats for the statistics.

.labels

(list)
labels for the statistics.

.indent_mods

(list)
indentation modifications for the statistics.
